game_title: Function Test Arena – Frozen Well Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Well, a frozen village well: the hold guard must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing yeti raiders.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Well: a frozen village well
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Well, repeat each round: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing yeti raiders. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the tests_passed value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about tests_passed to power up the hold guard and open the wall banner.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 2 (intro tier): Function Test Arena
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tests_passed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Frozen Well.
